name: R2-10 DEV/EVAL protocol -- reuses R2-09B firewall and R2-09A DEV corpus verbatim
principle: DEV is for implementation development, predictor family selection, hyperparameter selection, and threshold/configuration selection. EVAL remains held out; no EVAL result may influence predictor selection or configuration. R2-10 does not regenerate any frozen manifest to obtain different hashes.

dev_corpus.reuse_policy: R2-10 DEV tournament (next phase, not this Phase 0) MUST iterate the SAME 8 selected_instances (cell_id, trace_sha256) already frozen there -- no new DEV capture, no new DEV selection. Binding is by digest; tests/test_r2_10_contract.py asserts the referenced manifest's digest is unchanged from the value recorded here.

eval_firewall.r2_10_phase0_action: NONE -- Phase 0 does not open, read eval_results, or alter eval_manifest.json. tests/test_r2_10_contract.py asserts eval_manifest.json is byte-identical to its state at R2-09B freeze (same sha256) and that eval_results/opened_utc remain null.
eval_firewall.note: No EVAL capture currently exists in the repository for any of the 4 held-out instances (coding/reasoning/summarization/instruction); this is expected and must not be treated as a gap to fill in Phase 0.

what_dev_is_used_for_in_the_next_phase: hyperparameter grid selection within the finite, pre-registered grids in predictor_space.json (selection_rule.json governs the exact statistic)
what_dev_is_never_used_for: reporting a confirmatory R2-10 result (that requires EVAL, out of scope for this phase and for the next phase's DEV tournament, which remains a DEV-only diagnostic until a future EVAL-opening contract amendment)
